model.name: DropDispatcher.acceptDropIntoContainer
model.description: A folder is a drop target: DropDispatcher ROUTES a drop onto a folder node (recognize folder-as-target + resolve dest by one identity). ★ CONTAINMENT DELEGATES to R40.84 RbTraceTree.reDeriveDirectChildren (Method 1e5c4233 / Impl 8693dc2b) for the in-place add+render — DropDispatcher MUST NOT carry a 2nd containment/add path (req root-lens guard, LAW-8). crossRef R40.83/R40.84 containment family.
